artworks.title: Ornament in Hexagonal Shape
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental floral design. The image shows a central floral motif resembling a flower with radiating petals, surrounded by swirling leaf patterns. The background is dark, contrasting with the lighter line work of the floral design. The drawing's borders are uneven and have an antique appearance.

artworks.title: Panel of Ornament with a Satyress Feeding Two Children
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.1 x 4.5 cm (2 13/16 x 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image contains intricate lines and shapes forming an abstract composition with a symmetrical design. There are winged human figures with muscular torsos and distinct facial features at the center, along with smaller mythical figures resembling cherubs and satyrs. Above, there are birds and other creatures intertwined in ornate patterns. The arrangement evokes classical friezes or decorative panels, with each element leading the viewer's eye around the image, creating a sense of harmony and balance.

artworks.title: Roman General Addressing His Troops
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in classical attire. The drawing features a central figure surrounded by others in what may be a crowded scene. The figures are dressed in tunics and armor, holding spears or staffs, and are in animated poses. The background is filled with more figures. The style of the drawing includes dark, bold lines and shading.

artworks.title: Horatius Cocles
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 5.1 x 7.9 cm (2 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene. It depicts a group of armored warriors engaged in combat on a narrow wooden bridge or platform over a body of water. The figures are shown in dynamic poses, brandishing swords and shields. Some warriors wear helmets with plumage. Below the bridge, two figures are shown in the water. The overall tone of the image is intense and action-packed, conveying a moment of ancient warfare and struggle. The rich detail in the etching work emphasizes the movement and tension of the scene.

artworks.title: Mucius Scaevola
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 5.3 x 8 cm (2 1/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with various figures and horses. The drawing shows a composition of multiple figures gathered around a seated figure. The central figure is surrounded by attendants and guards. The scene unfolds under the night sky with a crescent moon. The drawing displays intricate detailing in the attire and decorations. A sleeping figure lies near the base of the seated structure, adding to the complexity of the narrative. The overall style suggests a dramatic, possibly historical or mythical, narrative full of symbolism and character interaction.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Galatea
artworks.description: The image depicts several winged figures with bows and arrows flying in the clouds. Below them, there are figures interacting with sea creatures in the sea. One central figure stands in a dynamic pose, appearing to direct others. The composition is bustling with movement and intricate line work.

artworks.title: The Sleeping Shepherd; Early Morning
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor and opaque white with gold highlights
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 9.5 x 7.8 cm (3 3/4 x 3 1/16 in.)
overall (mat size): 27.9 x 35.6 cm (11 x 14 in.)
artworks.description: Through the arched, vine-covered trellis, we see a pastoral scene. A figure is reclining against a rustic structure covered with climbing plants with yellow flowers. In the background, there is a flock of sheep and two cows being led by a figure. The sky displays muted purples and pinks, transitioning into evening, while the grass and foliage are depicted in rich greens and browns. The brushwork combines fine details for plants and figures with broader strokes for the sky and landscape, creating a harmonious composition.

artworks.title: The Morning of Life
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with figures interacting in a natural setting. Children and animals are engaged in various activities near the viewer. Trees and foliage obscure the horizon, creating a dense canopy. Light is coming from the back right, creating contrast between light and shadow. The artwork is detailed with etching, using linework and cross-hatching for texture. A monochromatic color palette of brownish-gray sets a nostalgic mood, emphasizing the central light source and details of the setting.

artworks.title: Rhetoric
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a seated woman on a block or low wall. Her upper body is leaning slightly forward with her left hand on her knee and her right hand hanging by her side. She has delicate facial features, neatly arranged hair, and is dressed in a draped garment with a cinched waistband and exposed shoulders. To her left on a platform, there is a cherubic figure with wings reading a book, with another book on the surface. The setting includes a column and a window opening in the background. The top left corner is inscribed with "RHETORICA" and an ornate "P G" above it.

artworks.title: The Pharisees Wish to Stone Christ
artworks.description: The image shows five figures depicted from head to toe. The central figure on the left wears a long robe and a tall hat, gesturing towards the figure on the right. The central figure has a prominent beard and a serious expression. The other figures on the left vary in gestures and attire. The figure on the far right stands slightly apart from the group, facing them. This figure has lengthy hair and a beard, with a halo of light around the head. The figure wears a long robe and gestures towards the other figures. The background contains a tall rectangular structure with an arched entrance, and the ground is covered with small dots. Two small symbols and the number "15" are printed at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Virginius Killing His Daughter
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in an interior setting. The group is wearing historical attire. In the center, one figure is being led or restrained by two others, one of whom is holding a sword. Other figures are nearby, engaged in conversation or debate. One figure is sitting on a throne-like chair holding a spear. The background includes architectural elements such as columns and spears against a wall, suggesting a formal or judicial setting. The style features intricate linework and shading, typical of etchings or engravings, giving the image a detailed appearance.

artworks.title: Paris Writing Words of Love to Oenone
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an outdoor setting. One figure is a man carving something into a tree bark, while the other figure, a woman, is seated next to him. The man is nude except for a cloth draped over part of his body, and the woman is looking at him with her head turned slightly. They are surrounded by trees and foliage, with a small animal visible nearby.

artworks.title: Medea Returning the Penates to Jason
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One figure is seated and the other is standing. The seated figure is partially covered by a cloth, with short, curly hair and looking at the standing figure. The standing figure is wearing a detailed helmet and a short, pleated garment. Their hand is extended towards the seated figure, holding a small sculpture of a winged creature with a humanoid figure on top. The background has detailed drapery hanging in soft folds.

artworks.title: Tomyris with the Head of Cyrus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures under a canopy of tree branches. One figure is muscular and nude with a crown holding a sword. The other figure is armored and presents a decapitated head to the crowned figure. The drawing is detailed with texture and fabric.

artworks.title: To Feed the Hungry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dining scene inside a home depicting domestic activities. The drawing shows a roundel with a table covered with a cloth, a person sitting behind it, and another standing beside it. A small dog sits at the feet of these figures. The person behind the table has a radiant face, while the standing person is gesturing. Another person is in the background holding a pail. The scene seems to be in a kitchen or dining area, decorated with a curtain in the background. The artwork features intricate linework and attention to texture, enhancing the realism of the domestic setting.

artworks.title: To Clothe the Naked
artworks.description: The image shows an interior scene with three figures. One figure is seated while the other two are standing. The seated figure has a halo around its head and is gesturing with its hands. One of the standing figures is offering a bowl to the seated figure. The figures are dressed in robes. There is an inscription above them. The scene is rendered with intricate details and cross-hatching techniques to convey texture and depth. The composition is within a circular border. The focus is on the interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: To Give Drink to the Thirsty
artworks.description: The image shows two figures on the left side. The seated figure on the left is wearing a robe and appears to have long hair and a beard. There are radiant lines around the head. The person is holding a cup or small vessel. The figure standing next to them is pouring a liquid into the cup from a larger jug. The standing figure is dressed in period clothing with a cap and hose with puffed elements. Two more individuals are behind them, one in a softly draped dress with puffed sleeves, and the other partially obscured, possibly wearing a cap. In the background, there is a tree with foliage at the top left.

artworks.title: To Visit the Imprisoned
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures interacting in a historical scene. The scene depicts a group of four individuals gathered around a wooden structure, with one figure standing out due to the radiant lines emanating from their head. This figure reaches out with an expression of grace or authority. The structure appears to have two feet protruding from it, bound in shackles. The setting gives the impression of an interior with an arched ceiling and possibly barred windows, suggesting a prison or locked enclosure. The style of attire and the tone of the drawing suggest a historical or biblical theme, possibly Renaissance in style, with intricate lines and textures.

artworks.title: To House the Pilgrims
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals interacting at the threshold of a door. The scene is depicted within a circular frame and is rendered in an intricate and detailed engraving style. The main figure on the left is clothed in a long robe and large hat, with one hand raised as if gesturing, while holding a cane with the other hand. The central figure, a woman, is wearing a headscarf and long dress, and is depicted with a hand resting on the shoulder of the man on the left, holding a small purse. The third figure stands at a doorway, with one foot on the threshold. The background shows a textured wall and cobbled ground. The engraving displays attention to the folds and textures of the clothing, as well as the facial expressions and body language of each individual.

artworks.title: To Nurse the Sick
artworks.description: Four figures are depicted in the image. One central figure is seated, surrounded by three others. The seated figure has shoulder-length hair, a halo around their head, and wears long robes. The other figures are standing and appear to be interacting with the seated figure. They are all dressed in period attire with tunics and cloaks. A jug is placed on the platform near the seated figure. The background shows drapery or a tent-like structure. There is script at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: To Bury the Dead
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group performing a burial or interment. In this circular composition, there are four individuals surrounding a wrapped figure that is being lowered into the ground. The scene is set against a backdrop of a modest stone structure, displaying elements of classical architecture such as crenellated towers visible in the distance. One individual clasps their hands together, while the others are actively involved in lowering the body. The attire of the figures suggests a historical or classical setting. The detailed use of lines and shading gives the drawing depth and texture. The drawing captures a moment rich with emotion and solemnity.

artworks.title: Georg Pencz
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.2 x 8.4 cm (4 13/16 x 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned. The man has facial hair, shaggy hair under a hat with a large brim, and textured clothing layers. He wears a necklace and the background has horizontal lines. The text at the top reads "IMAGO GREGORI PEINS."

artworks.title: Wife of Georg Pencz
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.3 x 8.4 cm (4 13/16 x 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual has a stern facial expression, high cheekbones, a slightly furrowed brow, and deep-set eyes. Their hair is pulled back tightly and appears short or tucked under a covering. The person is wearing a garment with a high collar featuring ornate buttons or clasps and an overgarment draping over the shoulders. The background is a simple, textured pattern. There are horizontal lines encircling the portrait and some text inscribed at the top, with small initials or marks to the side.

artworks.title: Death of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a woodcut-style illustration depicting a group of figures surrounding a central figure. The image shows a haloed group gathered around a bed, with a heavenly scene above them including clouds, cherubs, and an enthroned figure observing below. The central figure is sleeping and surrounded by other figures with distinctive halos and expressions. The room has a patterned wall or backdrop in the top right, adding an architectural element to the drawing. The style is characterized by precise and detailed line work typical of religious woodcuts.
